observation.command: cd /workspace/app && pkill -f "nx" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; echo "=== stop nx daemon ==="; pnpm nx reset 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== remove nx cache/temp ==="; rm -rf /workspace/app/.nx 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /workspace/app/node_modules/.cache/nx 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /workspace/.nx 2>/dev/null; ls -la /workspace/app/.nx 2>/dev/null || echo ".nx removed"
